name: Awakening: a strong placement test starts the Player at rank C, never higher

planSteps.description: Open the app at / and wait up to 30 seconds for a black screen with the text 'TOUCH TO ESTABLISH CONTACT' (a Flutter web app; it can take a while to load, and controls are exposed in the accessibility tree)
Click 'TOUCH TO ESTABLISH CONTACT'
Wait 6 seconds while the emblem forms and the '[ NOTIFICATION ]' window types its message
Click 'ACCEPT' once (this test build accepts a click in place of the hold)
On the 'CHOOSE YOUR SYSTEM' screen, click the FITNESS card
Click 'BIND FITNESS'
On the 'PLACEMENT TEST' screen, click the big number for 'Most push-ups you can do in one set'
Press the Backspace key three times to empty it
Type 80 with the keyboard (key presses, not a programmatic fill)
On the 'PLACEMENT TEST' screen, click the big number for 'Minutes to walk or jog 1 km'
Press the Backspace key three times to empty it
Type 4 with the keyboard (key presses, not a programmatic fill)
Click 'SUBMIT'
Wait 3 seconds for the rank badge and the '[ DAILY QUEST ]' cards to appear
Click 'CONTINUE'
Click 'CONFIRM TARGETS' on the 'LOCK TARGETS' screen (the web build lists no apps; that is expected)
Click 'SET REST PERIOD' on the 'REST PERIOD' screen
On the 'PENALTY TERMS' screen, scroll the list of terms down to the last term, 'The System does not negotiate.', until the text 'ALL TERMS READ' appears
Click 'HOLD TO ACCEPT' once (this test build accepts a click in place of the hold)
Click 'ENTER' on the '[ PLAYER REGISTERED ]' window
The '[ DAILY QUEST ]' window lists 'Jog' showing '0.0 / 2.0 km' and 'Push-ups' showing '0 / 30' (the rank C quest), and the top bar shows 'RANK C'
